project: Wuxia Life P93 Medical Endgame Playable Implementation
description: Lightweight implementation of medical_sage_healer endgame / final legacy stage (Medical Legacy Echo / 医名身后事). Strictly follows P92 contract: 1 auto echo event + 6 expression updates, 6 variants (3 compassionate + 3 pragmatic), no stat changes, tavern-born medical healer flavor.

userStories.title: Wire medical endgame echo event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the medical endgame echo event wired through the existing event system so players on the medical route encounter a final legacy echo with 6 distinct variants.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure 6 medical_endgame_echo auto events in sample-lines-spine.json (2 variants × 3 choices)
Trigger conditions: medical_late_life_done + age 60-65 + mutex guard + exclude orthodox/demonic
Set medical_endgame_echo_done checkpoint flag + medical_endgame_identity_done
Set 6 variant markers: compassionate_ember/peace/legacy + pragmatic_fame_remain/wanderer_legend/grand_master

Branching based on late-life branch markers (compassionate_final→ember, compassionate_peaceful→peace, compassionate_legacy→legacy, pragmatic_fallen→fame_remain, pragmatic_wanderer→wanderer_legend, pragmatic_master→grand_master)
No stat changes (endgame is memory, not power)
No new event framework or scheduler
No regressions in P83/P85/P87/P89/P91
event_record target: medical_endgame_echo
stageSignals: ["medical_endgame"]
userStories.notes: 6 endgame echo events (3 compassionate + 3 pragmatic). Follows renown endgame pattern but with 2× variants. No stat changes — lightweight compliant.

userStories.title: Add endgame expression — sample line core (P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want the medical endgame stage reflected in my sample line status so the route feels like it has a meaningful final legacy identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Sample line cost label: late-life → endgame (仁心不灭·烬 / 医者从容·淡 / 仁心满天下·传 / 医名犹存·寂 / 江湖游医·遥 / 一代宗师·名)
Sample line current goal: late-life → endgame (6 distinct goals per variant)
At least 2 endgame-specific readable signals (cost label + current goal)
Six variants have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Two variant axes fundamentally different: Compassionate = spiritual/healing legacy, Pragmatic = social/medical reputation
Preserve tavern-born medical healer flavor
No new UI components
Done-flag-first pattern: check medical_endgame_echo_done before medical_late_life_done
userStories.notes: Core expression updates for sample line. 6 variants across 2 axes. Done-flag-first gate order.

Ordinary origin summary: endgame state update (different per variant)

userStories.title: Add targeted endgame proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the medical endgame event fires correctly, all six variants work, and tavern-born medical healer flavor is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof (late-life → endgame → expression changes chain)
Show 10 core nodes: pre-endgame baseline → event fires → Comp-A → Comp-B → Comp-C → Prag-A → Prag-B → Prag-C → cost label → current goal

Optional bonus nodes: endgame identity depth, ordinary origin expression, full chain traceback, mutex with other lines, branch matching, tavern-born flavor check, lightweight compliance, two-variant axis differentiation
No full lifetime exhaust required
Save as docs/test-reports/p93-medical-endgame-targeted-proof.md
userStories.notes: Targeted proof with 10 core + 7 bonus nodes. 6 variants = richer than renown endgame proof.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the medical endgame stage so future edits do not break the first medical endgame milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: New test file tests/p93TavernHandMedicalEndgameSpineTests.ts covering endgame stage
Group 1: Event wiring (4-5 tests) — 6 events exist, auto type, age range, conditions
Group 2: Pre-endgame baseline (2 tests) — post-late-life pre-endgame state
Group 3: Comp-A post-endgame (3-4 tests) — flags + cost label + current goal
Group 4: Comp-B post-endgame (3-4 tests)
Group 5: Comp-C post-endgame (3-4 tests)
Group 6: Prag-A post-endgame (3-4 tests)
Group 7: Prag-B post-endgame (3-4 tests)
Group 8: Prag-C post-endgame (3-4 tests)
Group 9: No regression P83/P85/P87/P89/P91 (5+ tests)
Group 10: Endgame identity verification (6-7 tests) — 6 variants + all different + two-axis difference
No stat changes verification
Typecheck passes
~30-37 tests total
userStories.notes: 10 test groups (~30-37 assertions). 6 variants = 2× renown's test coverage. No regression on 5 prior stages.

userStories.title: Produce P93 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the medical endgame implementation and confirms the medical route is fully closed for Wave 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Output docs/test-reports/p93-medical-endgame-closure-report.md
Summarize event wiring, expression updates, targeted proof, regression test results
Clarify whether medical route is fully closed (bridge→entry→on-ramp→pressure→payoff→late-life→endgame)
List deferred larger medical-expansion items
Confirm lightweight constraint is maintained
Confirm no regressions in P83/P85/P87/P89/P91
Summarize Wave 1 medical route completion status
Verify two variants (compassionate vs pragmatic) remain fundamentally different axes
userStories.notes: Closure report with medical route full-closure assessment. Wave 1 medical_sage_healer tavern_hand seed complete after P93.
